svg.title: XXI. The World: batmon
svg.desc: XXI. The World, reversed. Software. Dead simple battery monitor in Go, with the ability to emit events on change.. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), Thence issuing we again beheld the stars. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 364. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
